english.title: Withhold information which a local housing authority reasonably required in connection with its functions
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in connection with the exercise by **(..SPECIFY HOUSING AUTHORITY..), a local housing authority, of their functions under Part VI of the Housing Act 1996, knowingly withheld information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), which the authority had reasonably required you to give in connection with the exercise of those functions
english.legislation: Contrary to section 171(1)(b) and (2) of the Housing Act 1996.
